cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll name the coworker who reported your lateness if you name whoever reported mine.

beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then I'll trade departments. Names cost names.
